body.x: [Pipeline Position] Academic, Curriculum and Faculty Coordination Associate (Africa Regional Office) [Based in Kigali]
***This is a pipeline position created to prepare for anticipated hiring needs. Final hiring decisions will be made following internal review processes.***

We are seeking an Academic, Curriculum and Faculty Coordination Associate for a 2-year-regular position (renewable) to work within Africa Regional Office at the International Vaccine Institute in Kigali, Rwanda. (Duty Station: Kigali, Rwanda)

This role is responsible for supporting the academic, curriculum and faculty processes required to adapt, deliver and progressively institutionalize VEA4A training across the five participating higher-education institutions. It also assists with participant-data workflows, digital-platform testing and routine monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) data collection.
1. Academic workflow coordination and curriculum support
Coordinate academic workflows among HEIs, the Training Lead, IVI HQ pathway leads, faculty and external experts.
Maintain curriculum-development, review, faculty-assignment, academic-approval and institutional-transfer schedules.
Support curriculum mapping, contextual adaptation and technical reviews under the Training Lead’s guidance.
Prepare and track documentation for academic approval, credit recognition, accreditation and certification.
Maintain controlled versions of curricula, lesson plans, assessments, trainer guides and approved teaching materials.
Track curriculum revisions, academic decisions, approval conditions and handover actions.
2. Faculty and practical training coordination support
Coordinate with MSAT training facilities and faculty to align practical training schedules, resources and facility readiness with curriculum requirements.
Maintain faculty records covering expertise, availability, teaching assignments and development needs.
Coordinate Train-the-Trainer nominations, faculty preparation, mentoring, observations and trainer-clearance documentation.
Support technical working groups, faculty networks, programme reviews and digital-content coordination.
3. HEI readiness and programme data support
Compile academic and faculty inputs for HEI readiness assessments, gap plans and institutional-strengthening reviews.
Assist with participant-data workflows, digital-platform testing and routine monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) data collection under approved data and privacy procedures.
Bachelor’s Degree in education, curriculum studies, health sciences, life sciences, pharmacy, academic administration or a related field.
Experience in academic coordination, curriculum administration, faculty coordination, accreditation, certification or professional training.
Experience maintaining teaching, assessment or quality-assurance documentation with appropriate version control.
Ability to coordinate technical experts and academic institutions across multiple workstreams.
Familiarity with digital learning platforms, digital forms, participant-data systems and basic data-quality checks.
Awareness of confidentiality, data privacy and secure handling of participant information.
Experience with routine monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) data collection is desirable.
Familiarity with competency-based education or Train-the-Trainer programmes is desirable.
Accuracy and attention to institutional requirements.
Clear communication with technical and academic stakeholders.
Ability to support several workstreams and institutions concurrently.
Fluent in English (spoken, written), French is desirable
***IVI welcomes applications from all sections of the community. We encourage women to apply, especially from countries that are currently under-represented within IVI.***
